name: tooltip
title: Minecraft Tooltip
description: Original Java 26.2 tooltip background/frame and ASCII glyphs with Radix tooltip behavior. Native comparisons cover 180 composited cases at scales 1–3, fixed screen geometry and solid backdrops. Complex backdrops and other browser/GPU environments are unverified.
